title: Where Global Investors Are Finding Liquidity in Brazil’s Stock Market
summary: BTG Pactual reached its highest position of 2026 among Brazil's most actively traded stocks, while Embraer entered the top 10 for the first time this year, highlighting the depth, diversification and investor activity across Latin America's largest exchange.
